title: Implement read-only Linux runtime discovery
outcome: Collect Linux distro identity/version, architecture, package-manager availability and actual PID 1, then produce a fail-closed profile compatibility report without modifying the host.
scope: Parse os-release as data without sourcing it
Detect architecture and active PID 1 from runtime facts
Detect APT availability without invoking it
Validate exact curated distro ID, version and architecture
Return machine-readable compatibility report and nonzero exit on blockers
Test unknown facts, unsupported versions, init mismatch and legacy architecture
exclusions: No repository, disk, bootloader or network changes
No automatic authorisation from metadata compatibility
acceptance: Collector is read-only and does not execute os-release content
Unknown or mismatched facts fail closed
All supported profile versions and architectures are explicit
Independent reviewer inspects exact commit and test evidence
